raw:
Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 28
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer provided an incorrect “upper estimate of the total penguin population at the end of 2012” (stating ~59 million) without substantiating it from the Wikipedia page. This wrong denominator led directly to the erroneous final percentage (0.00049 instead of the correct 0.00033). The counts from the CSV (Total=344, Filtered=291) and the filtering logic were fine; the error stemmed from the inaccurate external population figure.
